issues.title: Cambodia to investigate private security firms over alleged links to scam compounds
issues.title_en: Cambodia to investigate private security firms over alleged links to scam compounds
issues.summary: Cambodia will investigate private security companies suspected of involvement in illegal activities linked to online scam compounds, including alleged collusion in the unlawful confinement and torture of people, following allegations raised in a recent Amnesty International report, a senior minister said. The post Cambodia to investigate private security firms over alleged links to scam compounds appeared first on Khmer Times.
